items.title: Ledger CTO Charles Guillemet to leave after nine years at company
items.summary: Guillemet helped establish Ledgers Donjon security lab and says his departure has been planned for months.

items.title: Binances $6.5B freeze order, Hong Kong suspicious of HYPE: Asia Express
